Sniff out and fix broken tracks. ---------------------------------- This [napari] plugin was generated with [copier] using the [napari-plugin-template] (None). ## Installation You can install `napari-vizsla` via [pip]: ```bash pip install napari-vizsla ``` If napari is not already installed, you can install `napari-vizsla` with napari and Qt via: ```bash pip install "napari-vizsla[all]" ``` ## Contributing Contributions are very welcome. Tests can be run with [tox], please ensure the coverage at least stays the same before you submit a pull request. ## License Distributed under the terms of the [MIT] license, "napari-vizsla" is free and open source software ## Issues If you encounter any problems, please [file an issue] along with a detailed description.
